An EvalJob may name more than one inference server, and play receives each by name. Reason: a match can seat players served differently (Manabot's next use is an LLM against an earlier experiment's final checkpoint; EXP-71), and a single server= would have to change then. Keep one server the simple, common spelling. Still same machine only, and still no LLM or hosted support built here.
